content.short: Astro Pump is a multi-chain token launchpad that launches new tokens on a bonding curve.
content.description: Astro Pump is a token launchpad where new tokens start on a bonding curve, with a pre-bond phase that lets early buyers claim refunds if a launch does not complete. It runs on several chains and is listed in Blockscout's Unichain app marketplace.
